args.title: Include currency in dedupe key to avoid merging distinct transactions
args.body: File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts. The dedupeKey function builds its key from date, amount, and description only, so two transactions that differ solely by currency (e.g. the same amount in EUR and USD) collide and one is dropped as a duplicate. Update dedupeKey to also include t.currency in the joined key so transactions with different currencies are no longer treated as the same row.
